Name: Earthy Recolour Edit Layers
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
photoshop files containing the adjustment layers i used to recolour the vanilla grass, dirt, water, cliffs, and minimap to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]earthy[/url] colour palette. you can easily apply them to your custom tilesheets in photoshop using [url=https://digital-photography-school.com/getting-started-with-layer-masks-in-photoshop-a-beginners-tutorial/]masks[/url]

these are for compatibility purposes only, so obviously please do not use these files to create anything besides patches for your existing mods' tilesheets

enjoy~
